name: Eyes of the Sea
text: Your eyes have adapted to the rigors of the sea. If you didn't already have darkvision, you gain darkvision. Additionally, you can see through natural phenomena that would obscure your vision underwater, such as cloudy waters, ink, smoke, and so forth, and don't need to succeed at a flat check to target creature within these phenomena. Finally, you can cast Truesight as a primal innate spell once per day.
